meta.name: Tallow Hearth Toad
meta.description: A greasy amphibian idol carved from hearth-wax. Socketed into a tool, its tallow melts only under extreme duress: when striking a volatile hazard block, it vigorously re-greases your mechanism, heavily repairing its durability instead of wearing it down. Useless on safe blocks.
meta.author: jules:session
